sentences.en: Correct.

sentences.en: Unless you're digging it up on your own candidate, which is done for precautionary methods so that you're ready for the attacks.

sentences.zh: 那么通常情况下，这是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: So there are typically lower level aides, usually in their 20s, who work in what is euphemistically called the research department of either a political party or a campaign.
sentences.zh: 通常会有一些低级别的助手，通常是20多岁，在政党或竞选团队中所谓的“研究部门”工作。

sentences.en: And what these folks will do is they will first go into newspaper archives, search for past quotes.
sentences.zh: 这些人会做的是，首先进入报纸档案库，搜索过去的引语。

sentences.en: And then when they get a little bit more aggressive, they'll go to courthouses, they will go to colleges,
sentences.zh: 然后当他们变得更积极一点时，他们会去法院、去大学、

sentences.en: they will seek out transcripts, they will seek out divorce records, they will seek out campaign finance information, they will seek personal financial disclosures.
sentences.zh: 去寻找笔录、离婚记录、竞选财务信息、个人财务披露信息。

sentences.en: But Mikey, it's usually done, though, by mainstream political operatives in the two American political parties who do this

sentences.en: and sort of work with the press corps to get this information out there.

sentences.en: So I want to distinguish something.
sentences.zh: 所以我想区分一下。

sentences.en: How often is the information something that the campaign and its 20-something staffers find themselves versus information that is brought to them from the outside?

sentences.en: It's a good question.
sentences.zh: 这是个好问题。

sentences.en: You can probably see where I'm going here.

sentences.en: I can't.

sentences.en: Overwhelmingly, it is compiled at the staff level.

sentences.en: You know, for example, President

sentences.en: But that's the kind of thing that a staffer would dig into the archives and find.

sentences.en: Now, there are moments where folks will come over the transom, as we call it, or they'll even show up or they'll call on the

sentences.en: Too good to be true.

sentences.en: I mean, this is one of those stories that broke through to news outlets like Entertainment Tonight

sentences.en: So, Jonathan, let's talk about this offer that was made to Donald Trump Jr.

sentences.en: No, of course not, because this did not come from Republican researchers.

sentences.en: This is much different.

sentences.zh: 这是一个敌对的外国试图干预美国选举，以确保一个他们偏好的结果。

sentences.en: It's a different animal entirely.
sentences.zh: 这完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: So you're starting to answer this question, but is it common or not at all for a foreign government to be the source of opposition research?
sentences.zh: 你开始回答这个问题了，但外国政府成为反对派研究的来源，这常见吗？

sentences.en: I think there are some foreign countries that would like to play that role.
sentences.zh: 我认为有些外国确实想扮演那个角色。

sentences.en: It's just that they haven't really been that successful and many haven't tried because they know that there are or at least
sentences.zh: 只是他们并没有真正取得成功，而且许多人没有尝试，因为他们知道存在，或者至少

sentences.en: were pretty strong norms in American political campaigns that, yes, we fight tough and at times
sentences.zh: 曾经存在相当强有力的美国政治竞选规范，是的，我们斗争激烈，有时

sentences.en: dirty, but this is not the kind of thing that most mainstream campaigns for president in this country would do.
sentences.zh: 甚至肮脏，但这并不是这个国家大多数主流总统竞选团队会做的事情。

sentences.en: Most political operatives would see that and they would immediately forward it to their supervisors and say, what do we do?
sentences.zh: 大多数政治操盘手看到那个会立即转发给他们的上司，并说，我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: There would be meetings, conference calls, discussions.
sentences.zh: 会有会议、电话会议、讨论。

sentences.en: Lawyers.
sentences.zh: 律师。

sentences.en: Oh, heavens, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪，是的。

sentences.en: There was this example, I think it was Bush versus Gore again, where the Bush campaigns debate prep got in the hands of the Gore folks.
sentences.zh: 有一个例子，我想又是布什对阵戈尔的时候，布什竞选团队的辩论准备材料落入了戈尔团队手中。

sentences.en: And the Gore people saw these materials, I think it was
sentences.zh: 戈尔团队的人看到了这些材料，我想是

sentences.en: FedEx to them or something like that.
sentences.zh: 通过联邦快递寄给他们的，或者类似的方式。

sentences.en: So these would be materials that would literally help
sentences.zh: 所以这些材料实际上可以帮助

sentences.en: George W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush prepare to debate Al Gore on television.
sentences.zh: 布什准备在电视上与阿尔·戈尔进行辩论。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what did the Gore campaign do?
sentences.zh: 那么戈尔竞选团队是怎么做的呢？

sentences.en: They went to the authorities.
sentences.zh: 他们求助于当局。

sentences.en: So I wonder, Jonathan, with the juiciest possible material, do you really believe most other campaigns would have responded by shutting it all down and calling the FBI?
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，乔纳森，面对这种极具诱惑力的材料，你真的认为大多数其他竞选团队会选择拒绝并报警吗？

sentences.en: I think if they had gotten prima facie evidence of Hillary Clinton acting in a way that was clearly felonious, they would have, of course, pursued the material.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果他们获得了希拉里·克林顿有明显重罪行为的初步证据，他们当然会去追查这些材料。

sentences.en: But if they were just offered a promise with no details included of damning material, I think alarm bells would have immediately gone off.
sentences.zh: 但如果只是有人承诺提供一些所谓的重磅材料，却没有任何细节，我想警钟会立刻敲响。

sentences.en: The notion that somebody just sends an email that says, I have damaging information on your opponent, come meet with me.
sentences.zh: 那种有人发邮件说“我有关于你对手的负面信息，来跟我见个面”的想法。

sentences.en: There's huge risk in accepting an invitation like that.
sentences.zh: 接受这样的邀请风险巨大。

sentences.en: And one that I think a lot of campaigns would turn their backs on.
sentences.zh: 我认为很多竞选团队都会对此敬而远之。

sentences.en: So to you, Ben, can you understand the impulse from Donald Trump Jr.
sentences.zh: 那么本，你能不能理解小唐纳德·特朗普

sentences.en: and the others who joined this meeting to find out if an offer of embarrassing information about your rival in a campaign is actually there?
sentences.zh: 以及其他参加这次会议的人，想要确认是否真的有关于竞选对手的负面信息的那种冲动？

sentences.en: Look, I mean, there are always salacious characters that are attracted to have some level of influence influence on the political process.
sentences.zh: 听着，我的意思是，总有一些投机取巧的人想对政治进程施加某种程度的影响。

sentences.en: You know, the Roger Stones and the Dick Morrises.
sentences.zh: 你知道，像罗杰·斯通和迪克·莫里斯那样的人。

sentences.en: When you work on a campaign, you learn quickly to try to avoid people who are going to walk you into a trap.
sentences.zh: 当你参与竞选工作时，你会很快学会尽量避开那些会把你引入陷阱的人。

sentences.en: And this feels like an incident certainly more significant than something like that, because you're actually dealing with
sentences.zh: 而这件事感觉肯定比那种情况严重得多，因为你实际上是在与

sentences.en: a foreign adversary that crossed so many lines that I've never seen crossed in my career on campaigns and in
sentences.zh: 一个外国对手打交道，他们跨越了许多底线，我在竞选和

sentences.en: politics, not only on my side of the aisle, but on both sides of the aisle.
sentences.zh: 政治生涯中从未见过有人跨越这些底线，不仅是在我所在的党派，在两党都是如此。

sentences.en: So Jonathan, I wonder if this defense from Don Jr., that this is just opposition research, I wonder if that's going to
sentences.zh: 所以乔纳森，我想知道小唐纳德·特朗普的这种辩护，即这只是竞选研究，我想知道这是否会

sentences.en: become the defense for all these members of the Trump campaign when they're explaining all the various allegations of contact with the Russians.
sentences.zh: 成为特朗普竞选团队所有成员在解释各种与俄罗斯人接触的指控时的统一辩护词。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think that they might give that a go.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想他们可能会试一试。

sentences.en: But the problem is that it just runs into that one sentence in the email where it's presented as an effort to help Trump win by the Russian government that is inescapable.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，这正好撞上了邮件里的那句话，即这被描述为俄罗斯政府旨在帮助特朗普获胜的努力，这是无法回避的。

sentences.en: And I just think that any effort to minimize this is going to run headlong into that single sentence in the email about how this was an effort to help Trump win.
sentences.zh: 我只是认为，任何淡化此事的努力，最终都会直接撞上邮件中关于“这是为了帮助特朗普获胜的努力”的那句话。

sentences.en: Jonathan, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks, man.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，伙计。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他新闻。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Chairman.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，主席先生。

sentences.en: In his Senate confirmation hearing on Wednesday, President Trump's nominee to lead the FBI, Christopher Wray,
sentences.zh: 在周三的参议院确认听证会上，特朗普总统提名的联邦调查局局长人选克里斯托弗·雷，

sentences.en: was asked what he would do if the president wanted him to drop an investigation, a request Trump is reported to have made to the last FBI director, James Comey.
sentences.zh: 被问及如果总统要求他放弃调查，他会怎么做，据报道，特朗普曾向上一任联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米提出过这样的要求。

sentences.en: First, I would try to talk him out of it.
sentences.zh: 首先，我会试着劝他放弃。

sentences.en: And if that failed, I would resign.
sentences.zh: 如果失败了，我会辞职。

sentences.en: Comey came up a number of times.
sentences.zh: 科米的名字被多次提及。

sentences.en: Under questioning, Wray also said that in his conversations with the president, he was never asked to take an oath of loyalty.
sentences.zh: 在质询中，雷还表示，在与总统的谈话中，他从未被要求宣誓效忠。

sentences.en: And I sure as heck didn't offer one.
sentences.zh: 而且我敢肯定，我也绝不会主动提出这种要求。

sentences.en: And in an interview with the television evangelist Pat Robertson,
sentences.zh: 在接受电视布道家帕特·罗伯逊采访时，

sentences.en: President Trump expressed frustration with the trouble that Senate Republicans have had in getting the Affordable Care Act repealed and replaced.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统表达了对参议院共和党人在废除和取代《平价医疗法案》方面所遇阻力的不满。

sentences.en: What will happen if they don't?
sentences.zh: 如果他们做不到会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, I don't even want to talk about it because I think it would be very bad.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我甚至不想谈论它，因为我认为那会非常糟糕。

sentences.en: I will be very angry about it and a lot of people will be very upset.
sentences.zh: 我会对此非常生气，很多人也会非常不安。

sentences.en: Senators are scheduled to regroup today, after their recess, to discuss the latest version of the health care bill.
sentences.zh: 参议员们计划在休会后于今天重新集结，讨论医疗法案的最新版本。

sentences.en: I'm sitting waiting for that bill to come to my desk.
sentences.zh: 我正等着那份法案送到我的办公桌上。

sentences.en: I hope that they do it.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们能做到。

sentences.en: They've been promising it for years.
sentences.zh: 他们多年来一直承诺要这样做。

sentences.en: They've been promising it ever since Obamacare, which has failed.
sentences.zh: 自从奥巴马医改失败以来，他们就一直承诺要这样做。

sentences.en: It's a failed experiment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个失败的实验。

sentences.en: It is totally gone.
sentences.zh: 它已经彻底完蛋了。

sentences.en: It's out of business.
sentences.zh: 它已经倒闭了。

sentences.en: And we have to get this done.
sentences.zh: 我们必须完成这件事。

sentences.en: Repeal and replace.
sentences.zh: 废除并取代。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让你的客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
